mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase sulfamethoxazole metabolism, reducing its efficacy, while sulfamethoxazole may inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor clinical response and consider therapeutic drug monitoring if eslicarbazepine dosing is adjusted; monitor for reduced antibacterial efficacy or increased eslicarbazepine levels.
